symptoms: p95 latency rose from 180 ms to 4.8 s after a deploy; intermittent 502s; database connection pool saturated
root_cause: A new retry loop held database connections while waiting on a downstream tax service
resolution: Rolled back release 2026.10.14.2 and confirmed p95 returned below 250 ms; capped retries in the follow-up release
prevention: Add a connection-pool saturation alert and a load test for downstream timeouts

symptoms: Checkout requests timed out during a traffic spike; database CPU remained normal; pool usage climbed steadily
root_cause: A report query used the transactional connection pool and held connections for several seconds
resolution: Moved the report query to the read replica and verified checkout timeout rate dropped to baseline
prevention: Separate analytical and transactional connection pools

symptoms: Queue age exceeded 20 minutes after a provider slowdown; retries increased; no duplicate charges observed
root_cause: Unbounded retries amplified provider latency and delayed healthy jobs
resolution: Applied exponential backoff with a retry cap and drained the queue at a controlled rate
prevention: Alert on retry volume and queue age; add a provider circuit breaker

symptoms: Search returned stale inventory for one region after an index refresh; writes were healthy
root_cause: The regional index refresh completed before the inventory event consumer caught up
resolution: Replayed the consumer offset for the affected region and verified inventory parity
prevention: Gate index promotion on consumer lag reaching zero
